Name: Finders Keepers
Hint: Find a hidden item by searching.
Text: You searched and the room coughed something up. It was hidden for a reason. The reason was embarrassment.
Needs: event hiddenItemFound (emit when a search pass turns up a hidden item)

Name: Look Before You Leap
Hint: Scout a room.
Text: You checked before you walked in. Careful. Boring. Statistically alive.

Name: Beauty Sleep
Hint: Sleep in a safe room.
Text: Eight hours with a door between you and everything. Treasure it. It's the nicest thing that will happen to you today.

Name: Dinner and a Show
Hint: Eat a meal in a safe room.
Text: A hot meal, a small boost, no hunger bar. You're being coddled and we both know it.

Name: Defusing Personality
Hint: Disarm or clear a hazard.
Text: You turned a trap off instead of walking into it. Growth. Disturbing, but growth.
Needs: event hazardCleared (disarm, or a hazard burning out)

Name: Dress for Success
Hint: Equip an item.
Text: You put something on. It's the most dignified thing you'll do all day.

Name: Read the Manual
Hint: Open the Game Guide.
Text: You opened the Guide. Nobody opens the Guide. I'm suspicious and slightly moved.
Needs: event guideOpened (a UI command: emit from the guide action; the desktop overlay is client-side, so route it through a `guide` action too)

Name: Untouchable
Hint: Win a fight against three or more enemies without taking damage.
Text: Three enemies, zero damage. Either you're good or they were bad at their one job.

Name: Bad Odds, Good Mood
Hint: Win a fight against five or more enemies.
Text: Five of them, one of you. The audience bet against you. The audience is now broke.

Name: Opening Statement
Hint: Win a fight against three or more enemies in a single round.
Text: One round. Three corpses. The audience didn't even get to order snacks.

Name: Endurance Event
Hint: Win a fight that lasts fifteen rounds.
Text: Fifteen rounds. You two should get a room. Not that one. It's trapped.

Name: Back to Back
Hint: Roll two natural 20s in a row.
Text: Two natural twenties in a row. Statistically that's a clerical error.

Name: Let the Room Do It
Hint: Kill an enemy with a hazard.
Text: The room killed it. You get the credit. The room gets nothing. This is called management.
Needs: kill `how: "hazard"` (grid hazards and show events currently report "item"); then the trigger is where how = hazard, not `source`

Name: Spell Check
Hint: Kill 25 enemies with spells.
Text: Twenty-five spell kills. You're a wizard in the sense that nobody wants to stand near you.

Name: Roaming Charges
Hint: Win a fight against a wandering group.
Text: They found you in the corridor. They regret it. Briefly.

Name: Dense Material
Hint: Clear a dangerous room packed with extra enemies.
Text: A dense room, cleared. More enemies, better loot, same single you.
Needs: event roomCleared {dense} (6c room memory has the cleared flag)

Name: Mixed Drinks
Hint: Drink three potions in a single fight.
Text: Three potions, one fight. Your liver is going to need a union.

Name: Clutch Sip
Hint: Drink a potion while under 10% HP.
Text: A potion at the last possible second. Cutting it close is a lifestyle.
Needs: itemUsed field hpPct (HP before the drink: the state clause reads it after the heal, so it can never fire). Trigger becomes itemUsed where itemType = potion and hpPct <= 10

Name: Patch Job
Hint: Heal 500 HP in total.
Text: Five hundred HP healed. The dungeon keeps breaking you and you keep not staying broken. Stubborn.
Needs: counter healing.done (a `healed` event or a bump where HP is restored)

Name: Occupational Hazard
Hint: Take 100 damage from hazards.
Text: A hundred damage from the scenery. You're really getting the full experience.

Name: Hallucinating Winner
Hint: Win a fight after being awake for 40 hours.
Text: You won a fight on no sleep. The monsters might have been hallucinations. The loot wasn't.

Name: No Stone Unturned
Hint: Leave a floor having entered every room and found every hidden item.
Text: Every room. Every hidden thing. The floor feels violated. Good.
Needs: event floorLeft {floor, day, hoursLeft, roomsVisitedPct, itemsRemaining, kills}

Name: Scenic Route
Hint: Make a long-haul trip of more than three rooms.
Text: You walked a long way for a room. It was a nice room. It wasn't that nice.
Needs: the long-haul travel command (6c "Not done") and an event moved {longHaul}

Name: Retracing Regrets
Hint: Backtrack through ten rooms you've already cleared.
Text: Ten walks through places you've already beaten. Nothing there. Still, closure.
Needs: counter rooms.backtracked (a move into a cleared, visited room)

Name: Neighborhood Watch
Hint: Scout ten rooms.
Text: Ten rooms scouted before you walked in. You've never been surprised by a door. That's sad.

Name: Due Diligence
Hint: Fully assess five rooms.
Text: Five full assessments. Your insurance company would be proud, if you had one.

Name: Eagle Eye
Hint: Find three or more hidden items in one search pass.
Text: Three things in a single pass. That room has been hiding since before you were born.

Name: Pack Rat
Hint: Find 50 hidden items.
Text: Fifty hidden things found. The rooms' trust issues are valid.

Name: Bomb Squad
Hint: Disarm or clear five hazards.
Text: Five hazards defused. The dungeon has asked you to stop, in writing.

Name: I Told You So
Hint: Return to a room where a hazard has gotten worse.
Text: It got worse while you were gone. So does everything.

Name: Last Call
Hint: Survive into the last day of a floor.
Text: Day five. The floor is closing and so is your window. Everyone sensible has left.

Name: Cutting It Close
Hint: Descend with less than an hour left on the floor timer.
Text: Under an hour left. You made it. The stairs didn't even have to wait.

Name: Leave Before It Gets Weird
Hint: Descend from a floor after floor 1 within a single day.
Text: Day one and you're already gone. Strategic. Or scared. Same thing in a different outfit.

Name: Eviction Notice
Hint: Get forced down when the floor timer runs out.
Text: Time's up. Please collect your belongings. The ones you found, I mean.
Needs: event forcedDescent (check what the timer actually does at 0 off the stairs: it kills the crawler today, so this may need a design call)

Name: Insomniac
Hint: Stay awake for 60 hours.
Text: Sixty hours awake. The dungeon doesn't have to try anymore.

Name: Dreamer
Hint: Sleep in safe rooms ten times.
Text: Ten safe sleeps. You're the best-rested corpse in the building.

Name: Catching Breath
Hint: Take ten short rests.
Text: Ten short rests. The clock didn't stop for any of them. It's rude like that.

Name: Dining Experience
Hint: Eat five meals.
Text: Five meals eaten. Nobody said you had to. Overachiever.

Name: Must-See TV
Hint: Witness a show event.
Text: The announcer interrupted your day. That's the show. You're the guest star.

Name: Limited Time Offer
Hint: Claim a timed reward before it expires.
Text: Claimed before it expired. The sponsors wept. Slightly.
Needs: event showRewardClaimed (taking from a sponsor crate)

Name: Last One Out
Hint: Leave a closing section with under an hour to spare.
Text: Out the door while the door was shutting. Cinematic. Pointless. Cinematic.

Name: Surge Protector
Hint: Survive the last-day surge.
Text: The last-day surge, handled. Somewhere an intern is rewriting the schedule.
Needs: event surgeCleared (the surge's extra groups are all dead or the floor is left)

Name: Regular Viewer
Hint: Witness ten show events.
Text: Ten broadcasts. You're a regular. The announcer has your name on a mug.

Name: Terms and Conditions
Hint: Let a timed reward expire unclaimed.
Text: It expired. Of course it did. They always do and you always forget.

Name: Caught in the Collapse
Hint: Be inside a section when it closes.
Text: The ceiling came down while you were in it. Reviews were mixed.
Needs: event sectionClosedOn (showEvents.ts closing: the crawler is thrown out)

Name: Learning Experience
Hint: Botch a craft.
Text: The craft failed. Loudly. Please call it a learning experience.
Needs: event craftFailed (craft.ts botch path; `crafted` is only emitted on success)

Name: Spell Salad
Hint: Cast three spells in one fight and win it.
Text: Three spells, one fight. A buffet of bad decisions that happened to work.

Name: Window Shopper
Hint: Leave a shop without buying anything.
Text: You looked. You left. The shopkeeper took it personally.
Needs: event shopLeft {bought}: needs a notion of leaving the shop (the `shop` command is a printout today; fire it on leaving the room after a `shop` look)

Name: Participation Trophy
Hint: Open five bronze boxes.
Text: Five bronze boxes. That's a very beige afternoon.

Name: Brave, Stupid, Brave
Hint: Sleep outside a safe room.
Text: You slept in a hallway. Brave. Stupid. Brave-stupid.

Name: Waste Not
Hint: Drink a healing potion at full HP.
Text: Full health, one potion. It did nothing. So did you.
Needs: itemUsed fields: wasted (HP was full), and the trigger uses itemType not kind

Name: Collateral Damage
Hint: Hurt yourself with your own spell.
Text: You hit yourself with your own spell. The spell apologizes. The spell is lying.
Needs: damageTaken source selfSpell (a spell with an area that catches the caster: spells.ts / grid)

Name: Do Your Own Research
Hint: Take hazard damage while searching a room.
Text: You searched a room with an active hazard. It searched you back.
Needs: damageTaken field: during (the action that caused the time passing)

Name: Hope Springs Eternal
Hint: Search a room with nothing left in it.
Text: Nothing left. You searched anyway. It's the optimism that's going to get you killed.

Name: Fake News
Hint: Get fooled by a scouting report.
Text: The report lied. So did your eyes. You're running on sleep and spite, aren't you.
Needs: DESIGN: scouting reports never lie today. Delirious needs to make `listen` / `assess` wrong sometimes (the 6c sleep-state design says so) before this can fire

Name: Conscientious Objector
Text: You left a floor without killing a single thing. I don't know whether to be proud or disgusted.

Name: Midnight Snack
Text: A meal at three in the morning in a death dungeon. I won't judge you. I'll absolutely remember it.

Name: Persona Non Grata
Text: I used to like you. It's fine. We were never close.
Needs: the mood needs negative sources and a decay; today it only goes up (see the sim snapshot)

Name: Archivist
Hint: Fill 20 Codex lines.
Text: Twenty lines in the Codex. Someone is going to read that someday. Probably someone worse than you.
Needs: account-level counter (Codex lives on the account, counters on the crawler); read it in the state view instead: state codexLines

Name: Previous Owners
Hint: Find three notes from earlier carriers.
Text: You're not the first to carry it. The others left notes instead of forwarding addresses.
Needs: counter notes.carrier (picking up oddities tied to previous carriers: the Items sheet has the tag)

Name: Well, Actually
Hint: Hear Echo correct you.
Text: Echo repeated what you said and corrected it. You've been fact-checked by your own pocket.
Needs: event echoCorrected: Echo's Act 2 speech, which starts after Floor 3

Name: No Echo
Hint: Hear Echo refuse to repeat something.
Text: Echo wouldn't repeat it. Not couldn't. Wouldn't. That's new.

Name: In Its Own Words
Hint: Hear Echo speak with nothing borrowed.
Text: No echoes. Just a voice. It sounds like it's been practicing.

Name: Soothing Presence
Hint: Calm Echo five times.
Text: Five times you talked it down. It's working a little less each time. But it's working.

Name: Gasoline, Meet Fire
Hint: Feed Echo's anger five times.
Text: You've fed it five times. It's learning fast. Not the nice things.

Name: Know Your Enemy
Hint: Discover five boss weaknesses.
Text: Five boss weaknesses in the Codex. Next time they bring a knife, you bring a better knife.
Needs: account-level: the Codex's weakness entries; only 3 weaknesses exist on Floors 1-3, so Floors 4+ too

Name: Wardrobe Change
Hint: See every vessel Echo can start a run in.
Text: Handheld, music box, ticket stub, snow globe. Same voice, different outfit.
Needs: account-level: vessels seen across runs (run history is on the account)

Name: Serial Clearer
Hint: Clear five floors.
Text: Five floors cleared. It's a career now. A short one, but a career.
Needs: valid today, but unreachable: only Floors 1-3 exist

Name: Second Act
Hint: Reach floor 5.
Text: Floor five. Act two. The writers got bored and found some budget.

Name: Third Act Problems
Hint: Reach floor 9.
Text: Floor nine. Act three. Things start dying that you didn't kill.

Name: Thirteen
Hint: Reach the final floor.
Text: Floor thirteen. Unlucky for some. Statistically, you.

Name: Full Chorus
Hint: Find 15 shards.
Text: Fifteen shards. Echo is almost a whole voice now. You should be worried. You should also be proud.
Needs: valid today, but Floors 1-3 only hold 12 shards

Name: Credits Roll
Hint: Finish the dungeon.
Text: You finished the dungeon. Don't look so surprised. Everyone else is.

Name: Load Shared
Text: The show is dead. The dungeon isn't. Sonance gets to decide what it's for now.

Name: Node Taken
Text: Echo took the node and Cord took everything else. It's loud in here now. You helped.

Name: Peace Terms
Text: Four clauses, one signature, and Dox sleeping with one eye open. Peace is just a very tense ceasefire.

Name: Director's Cut
Text: All three endings. You've read the script, the notes, and the notes about the notes.
Needs: account-level counter: endings seen across runs

Hint: Die.
Text: You died. Don't take it personally. The audience didn't.

Text: Died in your sleep. At least you were well rested. For a while.
